title: Trustworthy AI Helper - Build & Refine the Prompt (Part 1 Lab)
summary: Students turn their Week 5 Core design into a working prototype and improve it by changing one part of the prompt at a time, logging each version, change and effect.
objectives: Build a working prototype of the helper using the structured prompt and improved data.
Refine the prompt across versions to raise output quality, logging each change and its effect.

body: Now build it! Today you turn your design into a working helper and make it better by refining the prompt, one change at a time.

worksheet.title: Week 5 - Lab - Worksheet | Trustworthy AI Helper - Build & Refine the Prompt (Part 1 Lab)

questions.stem:
v1: ... | effect: ...
v2: ... | change: ... | effect: ...
Best version: ...
questions.lookFor: Distinct versions where exactly ONE part of the prompt changes between them, each with its effect, ending in a named best version. Model: v1 'suggest a book' gave a vague list; v2 added 'one book, with a reason, using the survey' and the output became specific and justified. Watch for pairs changing several things at once, or assuming a longer prompt is a better prompt.
questions.prompt: Log each prompt version, the change you made, and its effect.

questions.stem: Columns: Version | Change made | Effect on the output
questions.lookFor: A complete log from v1 to the best version with a reasoned justification for the key change. This is the formative evidence for SD: iterates the prompt to a measurably better output and explains the causal reason for the improvement. For trial-and-error, prompt 'name the change and its effect'. Record SD as mastery/partial/not-yet.
questions.prompt: Record each version, the change, and the effect on the output.

questions.lookFor: Names a specific version, identifies a single change, and gives a causal reason for why that change improved the output (usually added detail, a named data source, or a required form). Reward a one-change improvement with a causal reason; 'it just got better' is partial.
questions.prompt: Name your best prompt version and the one change that improved it most, with a reason.

questions.lookFor: Recognises that detail added for accuracy can make the prompt longer and harder to follow, while a short clear prompt may leave the output vague - and names the balance they struck. Precise beats long; look for that judgement being made explicitly.
questions.prompt: Refine your prompt for accuracy AND clarity at once. Explain the trade-off you had to balance.

formative.targets: Integrated mastery - SD (refine prompts to improve output quality and explain why)
formative.check: Prompt-refinement log (v1 to best) with a reasoned justification for the key change
formative.successCriteria: Iterates the prompt to a measurably better output and explains the causal reason for the improvement.
formative.evidence: Prompt-refinement log (Trustworthy AI Helper Log, Part 1 Lab).
